purpose: Define intake rules, validation criteria, and status tracking for 5 external owner proofs

intake_rules.file_presence: File must exist at landing_path; must be readable; size > 0
intake_rules.owner_identity: Proof must contain owner metadata (company name, team, or signer); not placeholder-only
intake_rules.acceptable_shape: JSON: valid syntax + required fields; PDF: readable + legible; no template-only content
intake_rules.no_contamination: NOT frontstage-only (design, docs); NOT support-only (preparation); NOT stale; IS direct owner proof
intake_rules.not_duplicate: Not previously submitted version; not superseded; not placeholder re-upload
intake_rules.final_and_valid: Not draft; not conditional; not pending approval; unconditional and binding

validation_checklist: Evidence shape matches acceptable_shape from request pack
Proof is final, valid, unconditional, binding
Proof passes validator revalidation_hook: python3 scripts/ca_distill_validate.py

status_tracking.SEARCHED_NOT_FOUND: Proof not found in repo; awaiting owner upload
status_tracking.FOUND_VALID: Proof file exists; intake validation PASS; route-out ready
status_tracking.INVALID: Proof file exists; intake validation FAIL (shape, contamination, or identity issue)
status_tracking.DUPLICATE: Proof file exists; but is duplicate or superseded version of previous submission
status_tracking.BLOCKING: Proof status prevents route-out completion; holds release gate

gate_rules.all_5_found_valid: If all 5 proofs FOUND_VALID → route-out PASS → release_verdict transition to PASS → ROUND3_GATE_OPEN
gate_rules.any_missing_or_invalid: If any proof SEARCHED_NOT_FOUND or INVALID → route-out FAIL → release remains BLOCK_RELEASE → ROUND3_GATE_BLOCKED
gate_rules.no_auto_engine_execution: Proofs found/valid → enable ROUND 3 gate; do NOT auto-execute distill_engine in this round

next_steps: Validator auto-detects proofs and runs intake_checklist
Validator updates route_out_registry with status (FOUND_VALID, INVALID, DUPLICATE)
If any missing/invalid: generate ROUND3_GATE_BLOCKED_${TS}.json; maintain release_blocker
CA-DISTILL Lead coordinates next steps (proceed to ROUND 4+ or extend deadline)
enforcement: fail_closed: proofs not present = NO release; no auto-execution of distill_engine without all proofs
